tips: Rinse plastic bottles and cans thoroughly and let them dry before throwing away to make recycling easier.
Crush plastic bottles or flatten cardboard boxes before disposal to save bin space.
Remove labels and separate bottle caps from plastic bottles, as they are made from different types of plastic.
Avoid accepting plastic bags when unnecessary and switch to reusable cloth bags instead.
Separate food-stained paper from clean recyclable paper to reduce contamination.
Donate or resell usable items like clothes and books instead of throwing them away.
